statement.text:
(Well-known problem of A. I. Maltsev). Is it true that every locally nilpotent
group is a homomorphic image of some torsion-free locally nilpotent group?
    Editors’ comment: An affirmative answer is known for periodic groups (E. M. Le-
vich, A. I. Tokarenko, Siberian Math. J., 11 (1970), 1033–1034) and for countable
groups (N. S. Romanovskiı̆, Preprint, 1969).                            B. I. Plotkin
